name: Wen Qing
summary: A proud, extraordinarily skilled physician and senior cultivator from a branch family of the Qishan Wen Clan.

name: Xiao Xingchen

name: Liebing

name: Jiangzai

name: Shuanghua
summary: A graceful spiritual sword etched with frost patterns that warns of corpse activity.

name: Fuxue

name: Hensheng
summary: A flexible, razor-thin soft sword concealed around Jin Guangyao waist.

name: Suihua
summary: An opulent, golden-hilt spiritual sword forged in Lanling Jin Clan passed from Jin Zixuan to Jin Ling.

summary: A groundbreaking magical compass invented by Wei Wuxian that spins to indicate the direction of malevolent spirits.

name: Qiankun Pouch
summary: A spiritual fabric pouch with an expanded spatial dimension inside for carrying large artifacts.

name: Wangji Guqin
summary: The antique seven-stringed zither used by Lan Wangji for Inquiry and chord assassination techniques.

name: Shuoyue
summary: The elegant spiritual sword wielded by Lan Xichen, matching his pure and upright character.

name: Gusu Lan Clan
summary: A scholarly and austere cultivation clan founded by Lan An, renowned for their forehead ribbons, musical cultivation, and thousands of strict rules.

name: Yunmeng Jiang Clan
summary: A lakeside cultivation clan known for their free-spirited maritime ethos, lotus motif, and nine-petal lotus silver clarity bells.

name: Master Mo
summary: The master of the Mo estate and Madam Mo's husband.

name: Lanling Jin Clan
summary: An immensely wealthy and opulent cultivation clan famous for their golden robes, Sparks Amidst Snow peony motif, and forehead vermilion marks.

name: Qishan Wen Clan
summary: A massive, tyrannical clan historically dominating the cultivation world with their scorching sun motif.

name: Qinghe Nie Clan
summary: A rugged martial clan descended from butchers who cultivate the violent saber path instead of swords.

name: Moling Su Clan
summary: A newly emerged cultivation clan founded by Su She that imitates the musical techniques of the Gusu Lan Clan.

name: Meishan Yu Clan
summary: An ancient, matrilineally influential cultivation clan in Meishan and the birthplace of Madam Yu.

name: Baling Ouyang Clan
summary: A prominent middle-tier cultivation clan home to junior disciple Ouyang Zizhen.

name: Yueyang Chang Clan
summary: A regional cultivation clan in Yueyang governed by Chang Ci an.

name: The Cloud Recesses
aliases: 云深不知处 (Yún Shēn Bù Zhī Chù)
summary: The elegant, mist-shrouded mountain headquarters of the Gusu Lan Clan, famous for its serene atmosphere and thousands of strict rules.

name: Lotus Pier
summary: The picturesque, sprawling lakeside residence and headquarters of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan, renowned for its open, free-spirited atmosphere.

name: Golden Carp Tower
summary: The grand and opulent headquarters of the Lanling Jin Clan in Lanling, celebrated for its golden architecture and grand staircase.

name: Nightless City
aliases: Immortal Capital of the Nightless City
summary: The colossal, fortress-like ancestral domain and capital city of the Qishan Wen Clan.

name: Impure Realm
summary: The rugged stone fortress and headquarters of the Qinghe Nie Clan built into the harsh cliffs of Qinghe.

name: Burial Mounds
summary: An ancient, corpse-strewn battlefield and mass grave in Yiling heavily saturated with dark resentful energy.

name: Guanyin Temple
summary: A bustling temple dedicated to the Goddess of Mercy in Yunping City established under the Lanling Jin Clan.

name: Yi City
summary: A remote, perpetually fog-shrouded town famously characterized by its prominent coffin-making trade and funerary shops.

name: Dafan Mountain
summary: A sacred mountain shaped like a seated Buddha home to ancient stone shrines and a prominent soul-consuming goddess statue.

name: Caiyi Town
summary: A lively water canal town situated near the foot of the mountain leading to Cloud Recesses, famous for its loquats and Emperor Smile liquor.

name: Mo Village
summary: A mortal settlement and the estate of the wealthy Mo family, where the former Lanling Jin disciple Mo Xuanyu resides.

name: Qiongqi Path
summary: A treacherous and narrow mountain pass surrounded by steep rocky cliffs historically used as a labor camp.

name: Baixue Temple
summary: A peaceful Taoist monastery established by Song Lan and his master high in the mountains.

summary: A cluster of mysterious stone fortifications in Qinghe used by the Nie Clan to inter their ancestral saber spirits.

name: Wall of Discipline

name: Jingshi
summary: The secluded private residence and study of Lan Wangji located within Cloud Recesses.

name: Yashi
summary: The quiet and refined reception study located within Cloud Recesses used for hosting private discussions.

name: Library Pavilion
summary: A tranquil pavilion in Cloud Recesses that houses ancient scrolls, historical records, and cultivation texts.

name: Lake Biling
summary: A large, tranquil body of water near Caiyi Town that becomes plagued by waterborne spirits.

name: Xinglu Ridge
summary: A hazardous mountain ridge known as the Maneater Ridge in Qinghe territory.

name: Yiling
summary: A remote town and surrounding valley under Yunmeng jurisdiction, home to the infamous Burial Mounds.

name: Yunmeng
summary: A scenic, water-locked region characterized by vast lakes and lotus ponds, serving as the ancestral home of Yunmeng Jiang Clan.

name: Yunping City
summary: A bustling city associated with the Lanling Jin Clan where Guanyin Temple is located.

name: Lanling
summary: An opulent, highly prosperous region serving as the ancestral domain of the Lanling Jin Clan.

name: Gusu
summary: A picturesque, cultured region famed for its waterways, classical gardens, and the mountain peaks of Cloud Recesses.

name: Qishan
summary: A harsh, mountainous domain dominated by the Qishan Wen Clan and their vast fortresses.

name: Qinghe
summary: A rugged northern territory governed by the Qinghe Nie Clan.

name: Golden Core
summary: A concentrated nexus of pure spiritual energy formed in a cultivator dantian essential for wielding high spiritual power.

name: Resentful Energy
summary: Dark, volatile energy produced by the sorrow, anger, and suffering of unavenged souls and restless corpses.

name: Spiritual Energy
summary: The pure energy of the natural world drawn through cultivation to enhance vitality and empower spiritual weapons.

name: Demonic Cultivation
summary: An unorthodox cultivation method invented by Wei Wuxian that channels resentful energy through musical rhythm and talismans.

name: Inquiry
summary: A famous musical guqin piece composed by the Gusu Lan Clan that communicates directly with nearby souls and spirits.

name: Chord of Empathy
summary: A dangerous spiritual technique where a cultivator directly enters the memories and sensory experiences of a soul.

name: Water Abyss
summary: A terrifying aquatic vortex formed when countless water ghosts merge together into an insatiable lake-dwelling monster.

name: Emperor's Smile
summary: A celebrated, fragrant jarred wine brewed exclusively in Caiyi Town of Gusu.

name: Transportation Talisman
summary: A specialized spiritual paper charm that allows a cultivator to instantly transport themselves or objects across great distances at the cost of a significant amount of spiritual energy.

name: Night-hunting
summary: A fundamental practice in which cultivators travel across the human realm to eliminate evil spirits, monsters, ghosts, and fierce corpses to protect commoners and build their reputation.

name: A-Tong
summary: A young servant boy employed in the Mo family household.

name: A-Yan
summary: A young woman from Buddha's Foot Town who inexplicably lost her sanity and wanders the streets dancing with a vacant smile.

name: Blacksmith Zheng
summary: A blacksmith residing in Buddha's Foot Town and the father of A-Yan.

name: Madam Jin
summary: The proud and strong-willed matriarch of the Lanling Jin Clan, who is a close friend of Madam Yu and the protective mother of Jin Zixuan.

name: Deity-Binding Net

name: Dancing Goddess
summary: A ten-foot-tall stone statue sculpted by nature on Dafan Mountain

name: Sunshot Campaign
aliases: The Campaign to Shoot down the Sun
summary: A grand military coalition launched by the major cultivation sects to rebel against the tyrannical oppression and aggressive expansion of the Qishan Wen Sect.

name: Wen Mao

name: Jiangnan Region
affiliation: Gusu Lan Sect / Yunmeng Jiang Sect
sect_or_affiliation: Gusu Lan Sect / Yunmeng Jiang Sect
summary: A scenic geographical and cultural region south of the Yangtze River, known for its lush waterways, lotus lakes, and mild climate, which serves as the setting for sects like Gusu Lan and Yunmeng Jiang.

name: Lan An
summary: The historical founder of the Gusu Lan Sect who was originally a temple monk before returning to secular life, choosing the surname Lan, and establishing the cultivation clan in Gusu after finding his fated partner.

name: Malignant Curse Mark
summary: A dark, spreading brand inflicted upon a cultivator's body by malevolent spirits or curses that steadily expands across the skin over time.

name: Spirit-Locking Pouch
summary: A specialized spiritual pouch used by cultivators to safely trap, store, and preserve spirits, soul fragments, or resentful energy.

name: Wei Changze

name: Cangse Sanren
summary: A highly talented rogue cultivator and former disciple of the immortal Baoshan Sanren, renowned for her lively personality, exceptional spiritual power, and marriage to Wei Changze.

name: Baoshan Sanren
summary: A legendary, immortal cultivator who resides on a secluded celestial mountain and takes in disciples on the strict condition that once they leave her sanctuary to enter the mortal world, they can never return.

name: Yanling Daoren
summary: The first disciple of the immortal Baoshan Sanren, who chose to descend from his teacher's secluded mountain to enter the mortal world as a rogue cultivator.

name: Wen Zhuliu
summary: A powerful and loyal cultivator serving the Qishan Wen Sect, feared throughout the cultivation world for his unique ability to dissolve a cultivator's golden core.

name: Clarity Bell
summary: A silver bell adorned with the nine-petaled lotus motif worn at the waist by Yunmeng Jiang Clan members to steady the mind and dispel malevolent illusions.

name: Tortoise of Slaughter
summary: An ancient, deformed beast resembling a gargantuan carnivorous tortoise with a serpent head that dwells in a subterranean lake beneath Mount Muxi.

name: Chang Ci'an
summary: The leader of the Yueyang Chang Sect who is established in the narrative through his early interactions with Xue Yang during the latter's youth.

name: Lingchi
summary: usually translated "slow slicing" or (incorrectly) "death by a thousand cuts", is a form of torture and execution where a knife is used to methodically remove portions of the body over an extended period of time, eventually resulting in death.

name: Ouyang Zizhen
summary: A young cultivator belonging to the Baling Ouyang Clan who frequently travels and participates in various night-hunts alongside his generational peers.

name: Discussion Conference
summary: Grand recurring gatherings hosted by the prominent cultivation sects to discuss spiritual philosophy, showcase spiritual skills, and negotiate political matters.

name: Qin Su
summary: The gentle and supportive wife of Jin Guangyao, who was raised as the daughter of the Laoling Qin Sect's leader.

name: Wen Xu
summary: The eldest son of Sect Leader Wen Ruohan and a prominent, authoritative cultivator within the Qishan Wen Sect.

name: The Watchtowers

name: Mount Muxi
summary: A mountain region in Qishan where the Qishan Wen Sect forced young disciples from major clans to gather for indoctrination and a dangerous night hunt.

name: Supervisory Office
summary: A network of oppressive regional administrative outposts and monitoring stations established by the Qishan Wen Clan to surveil and enforce dominion over other cultivation clans.

name: Hanshi
summary: The private residence and study of Lan Xichen, the clan leader of the Gusu Lan Sect, located within the Cloud Recesses.

name: Qingheng-jun
summary: The former leader of the Gusu Lan Clan, who is the older brother of Lan Qiren and the father of Lan Xichen and Lan Wangji.

name: Jin Zixun
summary: An arrogant and confrontational cultivator of the Lanling Jin Clan and cousin to Jin Zixuan.

name: Jin Ling
affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan / Yunmeng Jiang Clan
sect_or_affiliation: Lanling Jin Clan / Yunmeng Jiang Clan
summary: A proud, short-tempered, and determined young cultivator of the Lanling Jin Clan.

name: Wen Ning
summary: A gentle and soft-spoken young cultivator from the Qishan Wen Clan skilled in archery and known for his fierce loyalty.

name: Jin Guangyao
summary: The polite, hardworking, and exceptionally tactful leader of the Lanling Jin Clan.

name: Yi Weichun

name: Fang Mengchen
summary: A young cultivator who harbors a deep personal grudge against Wei Wuxian and participates in the second siege of the Burial Mounds.

name: Leling Qin Clan
summary: A minor cultivation clan based in Leling that is subordinate to and closely affiliated with the prominent Lanling Jin Sect.

name: Jin Rusong
summary: Jin Rusong is the young son of Jin Guangyao and Qin Su of the Lanling Jin Sect.

name: Bicao
summary: Bicao is Madam Qin's personal maid and trusted confidante.

name: Meng Shi
summary: An educated brothel worker from Yunping and the loving mother of Jin Guangyao.

name: Lan Wangji
summary: A remarkably righteous and austere cultivator renowned for his strict adherence to rules, exceptional musical talent, and icy demeanor.

name: Jiang Cheng
summary: The fiery, sharp-tongued, and fiercely protective leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan.

name: Lan Xichen
summary: The gentle, empathetic, and universally respected leader of the Gusu Lan Clan.

name: Wei Wuxian
summary: An eccentric and brilliant cultivator known for his unconventional thinking, quick wit, and mastery over resentful energy.

name: Nie Huaisang
summary: A timid and seemingly inept cultivator who prefers collecting fans, birds, and painted scrolls over martial training.

name: Nie Mingjue

name: Jiang Yanli
affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Clan / Lanling Jin Clan
sect_or_affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Clan / Lanling Jin Clan
summary: A remarkably gentle, nurturing, and compassionate maiden of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan celebrated for her lotus and pork rib soup.

name: Lan Sizhui

name: Lan Jingyi
summary: A spirited, outspoken, and quick-witted junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Clan who frequently speaks his mind.

name: Jin Zixuan
summary: The proud and aristocratic heir to the Lanling Jin Clan.

name: Baifeng Mountain
summary: A scenic mountain range in Lanling that serves as the prestigious venue for the Grand Cultivation Hunt.

name: Madam Mo
summary: The domineering and bitter matriarch of the Mo estate.

name: Chang Ping
summary: The leader of the Yueyang Chang Sect, a cultivation clan based in the Yueyang region.

name: Demon-Subduing Cave

name: Xue Yang

name: Mo Xuanyu

name: Mo Ziyuan

name: Madam Yu
affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Clan / Meishan Yu Clan
sect_or_affiliation: Yunmeng Jiang Clan / Meishan Yu Clan
summary: The formidable, sharp-tongued, and fiercely proud mistress of Lotus Pier who wields the purple spiritual ring Zidian.

name: Jiang Fengmian
summary: The calm, gentle, and open-minded former leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan.

name: Lan Qiren

name: Jin Guangshan
summary: The extravagant, self-indulgent, and politically calculating former leader of the Lanling Jin Clan.

name: Wen Chao

name: Wang Lingjiao

name: Su She
affiliation: Moling Su Clan / Gusu Lan Clan (former)
sect_or_affiliation: Moling Su Clan / Gusu Lan Clan (former)
summary: The insecure and ambitious founder of the Moling Su Clan, formerly a disciple of Gusu Lan.

name: Mianmian

name: A-Ding
summary: A young maidservant serving in the Mo family household.

name: Jin Chan
summary: A junior disciple of the Lanling Jin Clan who participates in the Discussion Conference and the third-party hunts.
